evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To address this gap, we propose PriMobiBench, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating privacy leakage and visual profiling in screenshot-driven mobile agents.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Mobile GUI agents increasingly rely on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to automate smartphone tasks by interpreting screenshot streams.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Our results reveal substantial risks: (1) VLMs can directly extract sensitive information with up to 82.5% success rate; (2) beyond explicit leakage, they can infer user profiles from aggregated visual evidence with approximately 70% success.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We also introduce MobiLeak, a dataset of execution traces from 16 apps, covering 25 privacy attributes with 2,960 embedded privacy instances.
